EX-PARTE ENQUIRY REPORT

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name }}

Zone Name: {{ doc.zone_name }}

I, {{ doc.enquiry_officer_name }}, have been appointed on {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} as an Enquiry Officer by Sahayog Management in the case against {{ doc.employee_name }} (Emp ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}, {{ doc.designation }}) of {{ doc.branch_name }} branch on the alleged charges of {{ doc.issue_in_details }} from {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} to till date.

Background:

On {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, {{ doc.enquiry_officer_name }} was appointed as Management Representative. Through the mail dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_reported_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, it was informed that {{ doc.employee_name }} has proceeded on an Unauthorized Absence. The complaint mail is attached as Annexure-1.

On the scheduled date of enquiry, the alleged employee did not present himself.

Submissions from Management Representative:

Attendance Sheet - Evidence 1, indicating absence for the period, attached as Annexure-2. Attempts made to connect the employee were documented.

Unauthorized Absence Letter - Evidence 2 & Reminder Unauthorized Absence Letter - Evidence 3, dated accordingly, attached as Annexure-2 & Annexure-3.

Registered Post Acknowledgement Due and online tracking presented - Evidence 4, attached as Annexure-4.

Observation during enquiry:

• {{ doc.remarks or "No observations recorded." }}

Enquiry Findings:

Based on the evidence produced by the Management representative, it is concluded that there are adequate evidences to support that {{ doc.employee_name }} ({{ doc.designation }}) has violated Company’s rules and is guilty of the charges mentioned in the Unauthorized Absence Letter dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}.

Enquiry Officer

Name: {{ doc.enquiry_officer_name }}

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Attached Annexures:

Annexure-1: Complaint Mail

Annexure-2: Attendance Sheet

Annexure-3: Unauthorized Absence & Reminder Letters

Annexure-4: Registered Post Tracker, Email, SMS, WhatsApp
name: Ex Parte Enquiry
